analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($64.01) vs SMA5/20/50 ($65.39/$67.04/$66.99) — Below SMA5/20/50, indicating weakening short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($62.62)/SMA200 ($60.10) — Long-term trend remains strong.
· 52-week position (71.5%) + Current price level is in the upper half historically.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (50.9 → 37.7) — Entering oversold, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1124 → -0.3673) — Worsening, signaling continuation of the bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $64.68) — Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($63.90) — Based on 5-day low and Pivot S2 ($60.66), acting as short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($68.35) — Based on 52-week high ($70.13) and R2 ($70.50), a breakout could signal a trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Lower High / Sideways) — 5-day low equals 20-day low, indicating a sideways range with uncertain trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.50x vs 5-day average) — Increased volume on the decline confirms strengthening selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation/Distribution/Uptrend/Downtrend) — 5 consecutive down days and surging volume suggest potential downtrend continuation; conditions for observation.
